description: Record a payment the calling agent already made against a receipt. BotSupply does not hold or move the money. Requires the edit_token from record_approval. Appends a signed hash-chain event payment_recorded. paid_at defaults to now. Sets paid_before_confirmation when the payment time is before the confirm event, or when a contact was set and the receipt was never confirmed. Sets over_cap when amount exceeds the price cap. Those cases are stored and flagged. They are not rejected. Poll get_receipt and pay only when pay_allowed is true; recording an early or over-cap payment does not make pay_allowed true. Same as POST /v1/receipts/:id/payment.

amount.description: Amount paid, in the receipt price-cap currency. over_cap is true when this exceeds the price cap. The payment is still recorded.

edit_token.description: Secret returned once by record_approval. Required to record a payment.

external_payment_ref.description: Id from the payment rail. BotSupply does not look it up and does not move the money.

paid_at.description: When the payment happened, ISO-8601. Omit to use the server time. paid_before_confirmation is true when this is earlier than the confirm event, or when a contact was set and the receipt was never confirmed. The payment is still recorded.

name: record_payment
title: Record a payment
